schema.text: How adequate are motorcycle-specific parking facilities in your city? Think about secure parking and designated spaces near destinations.

en.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: How adequate are motorcycle-specific parking facilities in your city? Think about secure parking and designated spaces near destinations.

it.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: Quanto sono adeguate le strutture di parcheggio dedicate a moto e scooter nella tua città? Considera i parcheggi sicuri e gli spazi riservati vicino alle destinazioni.

fr.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: Les possibilités de stationnement réservées aux motos et scooters dans votre ville sont-elles adaptées ? Pensez aux places sûres et aux emplacements réservés près des destinations.

de.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: Wie gut sind die Parkmöglichkeiten speziell für Motorräder und Roller in Ihrer Stadt? Denken Sie an sichere Stellplätze und ausgewiesene Plätze in der Nähe von Zielen.

tr.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: Şehrinizde motosiklet ve scooter için özel park imkânlarını ne kadar yeterli buluyorsunuz? Güvenli park yerlerini ve varış noktalarına yakın ayrılmış alanları düşünün.

fa.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: امکانات پارک مخصوص موتورسیکلت و اسکوتر در شهر شما چقدر مناسب است؟ پارک امن و محل‌های مشخص نزدیک مقصد را در نظر بگیرید.

hu.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: Mennyire megfelelőek a motorkerékpárok és robogók számára kialakított parkolási lehetőségek a városában? Gondoljon a biztonságos és az úti célokhoz közeli kijelölt helyekre.

ar.#How adequate are motorcycle-specific pa: ما مدى ملاءمة أماكن الوقوف المخصصة للدراجات النارية والسكوتر في مدينتك؟ فكر في المواقف الآمنة والأماكن المخصصة بالقرب من الوجهات.
